meta.name: 3d-web-experience
meta.description: Expert in building 3D experiences for the web - Three.js, React Three Fiber, Spline, WebGL, and interactive 3D scenes. Covers product configurators, 3D portfolios, immersive websites, and bringing depth to web experiences. Use when: 3D website, three.js, WebGL, react three fiber, 3D experience.

copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在网页中实现3D交互效果。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add 3D interactivity to your website.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能帮你用 Three.js、React Three Fiber、Spline 等工具构建 3D 网页体验，包括产品配置器、3D 作品集和交互式场景，并优化性能。
howto.when: 当你提到“3D 网站”、“three.js”、“WebGL”、“react three fiber”或“3D 体验”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 React Three Fiber 做一个旋转的 3D 模型。
say.note: Claude 会生成 R3F 组件代码。

say.text: 如何优化一个 GLB 模型用于网页？
say.note: Claude 会给出模型压缩和导出建议。

say.text: 我想做一个随滚动旋转的 3D 场景。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you build 3D web experiences using Three.js, React Three Fiber, Spline, etc., including product configurators, 3D portfolios, and interactive scenes, with performance optimization.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "3D website", "three.js", "WebGL", "react three fiber", or "3D experience".

say_en.text: Create a rotating 3D model with React Three Fiber.
say_en.note: Claude will generate R3F component code.

say_en.text: How to optimize a GLB model for the web?
say_en.note: Claude will give compression and export tips.

say_en.text: I want a 3D scene that rotates on scroll.
say_en.note: Claude will provide ScrollControls or GSAP solution.
